title: The Disney cartoon with the Goodman trio
summary: Wilson recalls a Disney short, Make Mine Music, adding cartoon animation to the Goodman trio's recording.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: In that short, Disney, that Disney did with Goodman, I made -- and we recorded it first, and Disney had a keyboard and this keyboard was like a kite and these black and white things went right out into infinity. That's where he drew -- he drew a thing called Make Mine Music. He drew a cartoon character, actually added characters to the Goodman trio, for a little short subject in the movies.

Yeah, a little wavy keyboard that started at about that size, and then it got smaller and by the time it got bigger, it started out tiny, but still the same shape and went right on out to outer space.
